_readme: Connection map for the Private Pattern Airtable base — the engine's source of product/fabric imagery and copy. Explored 2026-07-12 via the Airtable MCP. Field names below are the exact Airtable field names (safe to pass to the API as fields[]). Use scripts/pull-airtable.js to sync images + copy into drops/airtable/.

fabrics.name: FABRICS
fabrics.notes: Fabric Story is ready-made caption material (mill history + hand/drape language). Closeups are mostly Cloudinary or supplier-store URLs. Data quality: a few records hold a pasted Airtable cell link instead of an image URL (e.g. fabric 3045.200/54) — the puller skips non-image URLs.

products.name: PRODUCTS
products.notes: Product Unique ID (primary) = name + fabric variant + cost. Images are Cloudinary product shots. FABRICS link gives the cloth behind each product.

collections.name: COLLECTIONS
collections.notes: Editorial drops. Currently: 'Back To Work' (back-to-work, Summer 2026 · Drop I, published, subhead 'Daddy's back… to the office'). CAUTION: some image URLs are storefront-relative paths (/collections/cover.jpg) — they live on the storefront deployment, not Cloudinary; ask for the storefront domain before pulling those.

collectionSegments.name: COLLECTION_SEGMENTS
collectionSegments.notes: Back To Work segments: I 'Tropical' Wool · II Hopsack · III Shirt Fabrics · IV Cotton Trousers. Story = one-line cloth story; About Rows = 'Label :: Value' spec lines — both drop straight into captions and ledger cards.

collectionItems.name: COLLECTION_ITEMS
collectionItems.notes: Purchasable pieces per drop; In Reel items carry lifestyle photography. Sheet Note is a one-line editorial reason — good hook material.

customerFits.name: CUSTOMER_FITS
customerFits.notes: Comma-separated Cloudinary URLs of customers wearing pieces. CAUTION: customer likenesses — get explicit approval before using any fit in public social posts.

templates.name: TEMPLATES
templates.notes: Garment technical sketches — potential quote/ledger card artwork.

offLimits: CUSTOMERS, ORDERS, Finance Ledger, TDC_MEMBERS, and the showroom/cart tables hold private member and business data — never source social content from them.
voiceCaution: Airtable copy is informational, not always on-voice ('premium', 'sophisticated' pass the linter but read like catalog copy) — run everything through generateContent overrides + the voice linter rather than pasting verbatim.
